Definition: El-Paran, a portion of the district of Paran
BiblicalUsage: El-Paran is a portion of the district of Paran. In Genesis 14:6, the text says "unto El-paran."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe El-Paran matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
